## What happened

The plan-review floor's Claude `critic` died on `You've reached your Fable 5
limit` on BOTH its initial spawn (~22:50Z) and its one bounded re-spawn
(~23:50Z), which followed a 50-minute hold. Each death was immediate. Phase-2
lens critics return in-context, so there is no durable output surface; the
probe is vacuous by construction and nothing was posted either time.

This is the exact terminal `steps/09-step-5.md` § Step 5b item 4 prescribes
for a Claude reviewer/critic with no durable verdict after its bounded
re-spawn, taken verbatim rather than improvised.

## Fleet evidence

Four deaths of this class this session (planner ~22:00Z, planner-retry
~22:30Z, critic ~22:50Z, critic-respawn ~23:50Z), on top of four on #2387
(21:12Z / 21:12Z / 21:24Z / 21:56Z). Eight total. The pool has been
continuously dry for roughly 2h40m (21:12Z through 23:50Z).

Three distinct roles hit the same wall — planner, critic, and (on #2387) the
reconciler. The failure is role-independent and session-wide, which is itself
the finding: no per-role remedy in the existing ladders can address it.

## Why this session did not route around it

- **Retry pacing.** No 429-style escalating chain was run. Two single long
  holds (25 min, then 50 min) were taken instead — the pacing this task's own
  Scope prescribes. Both were insufficient; the wall outlasted them.
- **Cross-vendor.** Codex was used where it is VALID (authoring the plan) and
  refused where it is not. A Codex critic cannot review this plan: Codex
  authored it, so that is self-provider review — structurally the same
  objection the plan makes about the reconciler site.
- **Inline fallback.** NOT taken. The `[epm-inline-fallback]` carve-out is
  scoped to THRASH ("this very thrash mode", `steps/09-step-5.md` ~line 1140;
  the `context-hygiene.md` twin sits inside the thrash bullet), so it does not
  extend to quota exhaustion. Plan v1 independently DECLINES to extend it,
  reasoning that orchestrator-authored review is not independent and does not
  repair a shared pool. Composing the critique myself would have collapsed the
  independence the floor exists to guarantee.
- **Proceeding anyway.** Refused. The floor requires >=1 Claude critic and
  states Codex-only is insufficient; advancing to approval and implementation
  without it would have silently lowered the gate on a workflow-surface change.
